grid.evidence: 1 registered grid dataset(s); independent datasets are not one-to-one with manifest layers, and generalized/occupied-only semantics remain explicit.

event.evidence: 3 registered event dataset(s); event parameters and geometry role come from descriptors, not display layers.

population.evidence: No descriptor currently matches a standalone population dataset identity; population-derived indicators are not an independent denominator.
